title:
Little paws.
A whole lot of love.
intro: Planning boarding care for your pet? Learn about stays at Niu Niu Family Paws.
note: Part of your family. Close to our hearts.
servicesIntro: Start with the kind of stay you need. Confirm availability, care arrangements, and pricing before making plans.
dayDescription: Need care during the day? Check available dates and discuss your pet’s routine and care needs before booking.
nightDescription: Heading away overnight? Check availability and talk through your pet’s routine before their stay.
price: Prices and package details will be added once confirmed.
aboutTitle:
A little planning.
A more comfortable stay.
aboutBody: Tell us about your pet’s routine, the dates you need, and what helps them feel at home. Confirm the care arrangements before their stay.
step1Body: Prepare their name, age, daily routine, and any care requirements.
step2Body: Have your preferred boarding dates ready.
step3Body: Confirm availability, pricing, and handoff arrangements before a visit.
q1: How do I arrange a stay?
a1: Have your pet’s details and preferred dates ready. Contact details will be posted here once confirmed. We aren’t accepting bookings through this website yet.
q2: Where can I find prices and packages?
a2: Prices and package terms haven’t been confirmed yet. We’ll add them here when they’re ready.
a7: Yes. Explore Pet grooming on the Services page, then confirm treatments, suitability, prices, and appointment availability with us.
q8: Can I learn to become a groomer?
a8: We offer training classes for new groomers. Visit Grooming Academy for upcoming course information; dates, fees, and enrolment details will be shared once confirmed.
q3: What should I share about my pet?
a3: Tell us about their daily routine, feeding instructions, medication, and any special care needs. Please confirm specific care arrangements before booking.
contactTitle:
Good days start
with a hello.
contactBody: Public contact details and service location will be added here once confirmed.
footer: Niu Niu Family Paws Sitting LLC
footerNote: Made for the ones with paws.
illustration: An illustration of a dog relaxing beside a plant
storyTitle:
Their habits. Their comforts.
Their kind of stay.
storyBody: A good conversation starts with the everyday things: a favourite resting spot, a familiar mealtime, or how your pet likes to be greeted. Bring those details into planning their care.
petsTitle:
Tell us what makes
them, them.
petsIntro: Use these conversation starters to explain your dog, cat or rabbit’s needs. Suitability and specific care arrangements should always be confirmed before a stay.
dogBody: Share their usual walk times, energy level, lead habits and how they respond to other animals. Tell us what helps them settle after a busy day.
catBody: Describe their favourite hiding spots, litter routine and whether they prefer company or a little space. Mention how they react to a new environment.
rabbitBody: Explain their usual food, enclosure setup, handling preferences and quiet-time routine. Discuss any particular care needs before making arrangements.
prepareIntro: Keep the important details together. This is a planning guide, not a list of mandatory items; confirm what to bring and what care can be provided before your visit.
prepare1Body: Write down usual mealtimes, portions and any food sensitivities. Ask how food should be packed and labelled.
prepare2Body: Discuss allergies, medication and any support your pet needs. Confirm whether those needs can be accommodated before booking.
prepare3Body: Mention a favourite blanket or toy and what helps your pet relax. Check which belongings are suitable to bring.
prepare4Body: Confirm drop-off and pickup arrangements, the best contact during the stay, and who will collect your pet.
planningTitle:
A clear plan for
you and your pet.
planningBody: Before you commit, confirm the dates, care needs, price and cancellation terms together. A saved pet profile helps keep their details handy; it does not confirm a booking.
dayDetail: Discuss the day: arrival and pickup, meals, rest and your pet’s usual activity.
nightDetail: Discuss the whole stay: dates, sleeping routine, food and the things that help them settle.
q4: Can I book or pay online?
a4: Online booking and payment are not available yet. Signing in lets you manage your profile and pet details; it does not reserve a place or confirm care.
a5: Read the cancellation policy and confirm the complete terms before arranging a stay. Exact deadlines, shorter-notice terms and the form of refund still need confirmation.
a6: Prepare feeding instructions, care notes and details of any familiar belongings. Confirm what is appropriate to bring and any specific requirements before your visit.
homeTitle:
Little paws.
A whole lot of love.
homeIntro: Care starts with knowing your pet. Let’s make room for their routines, their personality, and the details that matter to you.
homeSignature: Niu Niu Family Paws Sitting LLC
homeArtNote: A little familiar. A little more at ease.
experienceTitle:
Every little personality.
A thoughtful beginning.
experienceIntro: Before a stay, turn the things you know best about your pet into a clear conversation about care.
experience1Body: The shy hello. The favourite game. Start with who they are.
experience2Body: Talk through what they need and which arrangements are suitable.
experience3Body: Bring their everyday comforts into the plan, one detail at a time.
trustTitle:
Warmth in the welcome.
Clarity in the details.
trust1Body: Your pet is more than a name and a date. Their habits belong in the conversation.
trust2Body: Know what needs to be discussed and confirmed before making plans.
trust3Body: Ask questions, share concerns, and make sure the arrangements feel right for your pet.
homeServicesIntro: Explore everyday care, drop-in visits, dog walking, grooming and learning. Find the details in our service guide.
homeDayLabel: WHEN YOUR DAY TAKES YOU ELSEWHERE
homeDayBody: A place to begin planning daytime care.
homeNightBody: A thoughtful starting point for a longer stay.
homeQuestionsTitle:
A good question
is always welcome.
homeQuestionsBody: Find practical answers about getting started, pet details and changing plans in our dedicated guide.
homeContactTitle:
Let’s start with
your little one.
homeContactBody: Public contact and location details will appear here once confirmed. In the meantime, get to know the care approach and prepare your questions.
